item.title: Tesla tops Phl EV sales in June
item.description: Tesla ranked as the Philippines’ top-selling electric vehicle (EV) brand in June 2026, according to sales data from the Chamber of Automotive Manufacturers of the Philippines Inc. and Truck Manufacturers Association.

item.title: Hyundai launches ASEAN Cup fan campaign
item.description: Hyundai is bringing football supporters closer to the ASEAN Hyundai Cup 2026 through fan activities across Southeast Asia.

item.title: Porsche Phl marks 30 years with one-off 911
item.description: Porsche Philippines celebrated its 30th anniversary with a one-off 911 Targa 4 GTS and the local debut of the new 911 Turbo S Hybrid at the Porsche EDSA showroom.

item.title: Honda, Dunkin reward NAVi buyers
item.description: Honda Philippines Inc. has partnered with Dunkin to give customers a box of donuts with every new Honda NAVi purchased during a three-month promotion.

item.title: GAC unveils three-model MPV lineup
item.description: GAC Philippines has introduced three new multi-purpose vehicles that cover different price points and passenger needs. The lineup consists of the all-new GN6, E8 HEV and GN8 PHEV Executive.

item.title: Chevrolet sparks honors
item.description: The Chevrolet Spark EUV has been named the 2026 Electric Car of the Year by the Inter-American Federation of Automotive Journalism, or FIPA.

item.title: A feast for the fans
